017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021
022import java.net.*;
023import java.util.*;
024
025/**
026 * Pure, side-effect-free construction of the RFC 9728 / SEP-2351 well-known Protected Resource Metadata (PRM) URIs for a
027 * given canonical resource identifier.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * Per <a class="doclink" href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc9728#section-3.1">RFC 9728 &sect;3.1</a> and
031 * SEP-2351, the well-known segment {@code /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource} is inserted between the host and the
032 * resource's path component:
033 *
034 * <ul>
035 *    <li>Resource {@code https://host/mcp} &rarr; PRM at {@code https://host/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp}
036 *       (path-insertion).
037 *    <li>Resource {@code https://host} (no path) &rarr; PRM at {@code https://host/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource}
038 *       (root form).
039 * </ul>
040 *
041 * <p>
042 * {@link #candidates(URI)} returns the ordered client lookup sequence &mdash; the path-inserted URI first, then the root
043 * fallback &mdash; matching the ordered fallback SEP-2351 specifies.  The server hosts the path-inserted form (and, for
044 * a rooted resource, that <i>is</i> the root form).
045 *
046 * @since 10.0.0
047 */
048public final class McpWellKnownRouting {
049
050   /** The RFC 9728 well-known path segment. */
051   public static final String WELL_KNOWN_PATH = "/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource";
052
053   private McpWellKnownRouting() {}
054
055   /**
056    * Returns the path-inserted PRM URI for the supplied resource identifier (RFC 9728 &sect;3.1).
057    *
058    * @param resource The canonical resource identifier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must be absolute (scheme +
059    *    authority).
060    * @return The PRM document URI.
061    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code resource} is <jk>null</jk> or is missing a scheme/authority.
062    */
063   public static URI metadataUri(URI resource) {
064      var base = baseOf(resource);
065      return URI.create(base + WELL_KNOWN_PATH + normalizePath(resource.getRawPath()));
066   }
067
068   /**
069    * Returns the root-form PRM URI for the supplied resource identifier &mdash; the ordered fallback location
070    * (SEP-2351).
071    *
072    * @param resource The canonical resource identifier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must be absolute (scheme +
073    *    authority).
074    * @return The root PRM document URI.
075    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code resource} is <jk>null</jk> or is missing a scheme/authority.
076    */
077   public static URI rootMetadataUri(URI resource) {
078      return URI.create(baseOf(resource) + WELL_KNOWN_PATH);
079   }
080
081   /**
082    * Returns the ordered PRM lookup candidates &mdash; the path-inserted URI first, then the root fallback (SEP-2351).
083    *
084    * <p>
085    * When the resource has no path component the two coincide and a single-element list is returned.
086    *
087    * @param resource The canonical resource identifier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must be absolute (scheme +
088    *    authority).
089    * @return The ordered candidate list (1 or 2 entries).  Never <jk>null</jk>.
090    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code resource} is <jk>null</jk> or is missing a scheme/authority.
091    */
092   public static List<URI> candidates(URI resource) {
093      var pathInserted = metadataUri(resource);
094      var root = rootMetadataUri(resource);
095      return pathInserted.equals(root) ? List.of(pathInserted) : List.of(pathInserted, root);
096   }
097
098   /**
099    * Returns the servlet-relative request path at which this server hosts its PRM document for the supplied resource
100    * identifier &mdash; i.e. {@link #metadataUri(URI)}'s path component.
101    *
102    * @param resource The canonical resource identifier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
103    * @return The request path (e.g. {@code /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp}).
104    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code resource} is <jk>null</jk>.
105    */
106   public static String wellKnownRequestPath(URI resource) {
107      assertArgNotNull("resource", resource);
108      return WELL_KNOWN_PATH + normalizePath(resource.getRawPath());
109   }
110
111   private static String baseOf(URI resource) {
112      assertArgNotNull("resource", resource);
113      var scheme = resource.getScheme();
114      var authority = resource.getRawAuthority();
115      if (scheme == null || authority == null)
116         throw iaex("resource %s must be an absolute URI with a scheme and authority", resource);
117      return scheme + "://" + authority;
118   }
119
120   private static String normalizePath(String rawPath) {
121      if (rawPath == null || rawPath.isEmpty())
122         return "";
123      var p = rawPath;
124      while (p.endsWith("/"))
125         p = p.substring(0, p.length() - 1);
126      if (p.isEmpty())
127         return "";
128      return p.startsWith("/") ? p : "/" + p;
129   }
130}
